title: Rabbi Biva bar Zavda
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eichah Rabbati, chapter 3, on “Let us search.” Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be Rabbi Ba bar Zavda; he explains that the letters בי separated from ר׳, producing ביבא.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The proposed separation of בי from רבי and the change from Biva to Ba are Hyman’s explanation. No printed letter shapes or manuscript history have been inspected to establish that mechanism.

The actual Eikhah Rabbah chapter 3 paragraph beginning נחפשה דרכינו reads Rabbi Beiva bar Zavdai. Hyman’s Biva/Ba proposal and explanation of separated letters remain his textual argument; neither printed letter shapes nor a correction mechanism has been verified.
